## Course Overview

This financial mathematics course is designed for Master 1 students at a
business school. Over 18 hours spread across three intensive days, students
develop the analytical tools needed to compare cash flows across time, value
financing instruments, and evaluate investment decisions under uncertainty.

The course follows a three-step progression:

1. **Calculating and comparing cash flows** — time value of money,
   compounding, discounting, rate conversion, annuities.
2. **Valuing financing instruments** — loan amortization, actuarial cost
   of credit, bond valuation and interest-rate sensitivity.
3. **Evaluating investment decisions** — NPV, IRR, payback period,
   sensitivity analysis, and scenario modelling.
